description: This header file defines classes and functions related to display configurations within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It declares an interface for display configuration sharing ('DisplaysConfigs'), and component classes for handling display configuration flags ('DisplaysConfigsFlag') and configuration fragments ('DisplaysConfigsFragment'). It also declares functions for component creation using the 'fruit' dependency injection framework.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigs
classes.description: An interface for sharing display configuration data, allowing retrieval and modification of display configurations.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigsFlag
classes.description: A class derived from FlagFeature for parsing and handling display configuration flags.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigsFragment
classes.description: A class derived from ConfigFragment for serializing and deserializing display configurations.

methods.name: DisplaysConfigsComponent
methods.description: Creates a dependency injection component providing 'DisplaysConfigs'.

methods.name: DisplaysConfigsFlagComponent
methods.description: Creates a DI component requiring 'DisplaysConfigs' and 'ConfigFlag', and providing 'DisplaysConfigsFlag'.

methods.name: DisplaysConfigsFragmentComponent
methods.description: Creates a DI component requiring 'DisplaysConfigs' and providing 'DisplaysConfigsFragment'.
